surface_mechanism_description: Oxidation of the Ir surface by oxygen plasma during the initial growth stage, resulting in the formation of IrO2, which induces a phase change in TiO2 films from anatase to rutile and anatase multiphases, thereby increasing the dielectric constant.
evidence: The surface change of the Ir electrode caused by the O2 plasma during the initial stage of the TiO2 film deposition resulted in the oxidation of the Ir surface to IrO2, the crystal structure of which is rutile. This oxidation induced a phase change in TiO2 films from anatase to rutile and anatase multiphases, increasing the dielectric constant.
